test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A means of altering one's appearance to conceal one's identity
solution:
The correct answer is "**Disguise**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate word that substitutes "**a means of altering one's appearance to conceal one's identity**" is "**Disguise**".
 
• **Disguise** means to become **unrecognisable by changing the appearance or sound**. 
 
 
• **Example:** *The killer **disguised** himself as a labourer.* 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Distort **- make something look deformed.

 
 
• **Example:** *Jerome's nose looks **distorted** after the fight.*
 
 
 
• **Drape** - to cover a cloth decoratively.
 
 
• **Example**: *My friend helped me to **drape** the saree.*
 
 
 
• **Dress** - to wear clothes. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Tina, **dress** according to the occasion. *
